answer: A forestry agent network deters Sybils via staked physical spot audits. Each agent locks stake and logs signed telemetry hashes, covering dawn illuminance, gale wind loads, and nearby timber LiDAR scans, at claimed coordinates. Randomly dispatched inspection drones verify sensors and readings on site, slashing mismatches and forcing attackers to fund physical rigs and capital per identity. However, colluding auditors or severe weather can delay inspections and let phantom nodes persist.
